name: Safety Sky Fire Zone (3-Deep 2-Under)
formation: 4-3 Under Fire vs 11P Gun Trips Right

summary.motive: Create a devastating overload edge blitz using Strong Safety from depth on a Sky path while dropping the defensive end to take away the primary hot throw.
summary.keyDefender: SS (Blazing Sky Edge Rusher) & SDE (Dropping Flat Defender)
summary.whyItWorks: The offensive tackle cannot pass off the spiking SAM linebacker fast enough to pick up the safety arriving at full speed from depth.
summary.failureMode: A deep wheel route by the slot receiver into the deep void behind the blitz if the outside cornerback bails too shallow.

beats.title: Cover 3 Sky Disguise Look
beats.text: Dan Quinn presents a standard Cover 3 shell with SS aligned over Trips and SAM on the line of scrimmage, disguising the impending 5-man fire zone.

beats.title: SAM Pins the Edge, SS Launches
beats.text: At the snap, SAM spikes inside onto the right tackle, pinning him in place, while Strong Safety (SS) rockets off the edge with unchecked speed.

beats.title: Defensive End Drops into Hot Window
beats.text: Defensive end SDE drops off the line directly into the strong flat, standing right in the window of H’s quick hitch hot route.

beats.title: Strip-Sack Arrival by Strong Safety
beats.text: With the hot read denied by the dropping defensive lineman, SS levels the quarterback from the blind angle to create an instant turnover.

relations.tell: Strong safety creeps towards line before snap and launches outside as SAM crashes inside on tackle
